title: Joint Chiefs propose Operation Northwoods

tellings.quote: him this Operation Northwoods, you know,

plain: Dan Sheehan, a researcher, speaks on Jesse Michels's podcast in an episode about President John F. Kennedy and UFOs. He says that in 1962 the Joint Chiefs of Staff, the heads of the US military branches, put forward a secret plan called Operation Northwoods, and he links it to Curtis LeMay, a top Air Force general. He tells it to show how far military leaders of that time were willing to go.
